spec_git_text: The planned platform provides private repositories and history. This website contains only a fictional, read-only demonstration; accounts and repository operations belong to the owner’s separate private service.
spec_teams_text: Branches, tags, diffs, issues, pull requests, releases, organizations, roles, SSH and signing keys belong to the project. Collaboration and native Git transports still need implementation.
spec_hosting_text: Repositories accept any language. Static website hosting, builds and application execution are separate planned capabilities in isolated environments, without running projects on the platform host.
spec_copilot_text: Planned assistance is scoped to the account. Central AI interprets approved artifacts and recommends solutions. Repository changes require authorization; the exact Copilot boundary remains to be specified.
spec_sourceBoundary_text: AI has no direct access to hosted source. A separate analyzer produces hashes and filtered CST-derived artifacts. Raw CSTs may contain code and must not be transmitted unchanged.
spec_training_text: Using AI must not train or update model weights with your projects. Any future training requires separate explicit consent. Context retention and caches must be minimized and verified.
spec_providers_text: A local model or external provider may be chosen where supported. Provider fees are separate. That choice never overrides the source confidentiality boundary.
spec_sentinel_text: The planned supervisor checks service health and containment conditions using deterministic rules. AI must not disable it, expand its own permissions or erase audit evidence.
spec_approval_text: Planned sensitive operations require approval signed on a phone or separate device, bound to target, parameters and expiry, with replay protection. Private keys remain on that device.
spec_recovery_text: Containment must be targeted and preserve Sentinel, logs and emergency access. Encrypted backups, restoration and lost-phone replacement must be defined and tested before operation. Administration and recovery interfaces must remain separate from the public interface.
spec_resources_text: CPU, memory and storage quotas must preserve supervision and recovery capacity. The proposed initial host has 64 GB of RAM: a design target, not a performance guarantee.
spec_freeAccess_title: Ordinary access and AI without an AI subscription
spec_freeAccess_text: The license provides for free ordinary access. The model proposes AI without a platform AI subscription. Ancillary services and external provider costs have separate terms to clarify before commercial launch.
spec_donations_text: Planned donations support infrastructure, maintenance and continuity. They do not buy ownership, privileged access or extra rights to proprietary components. Funding targets self-sufficiency and continuity, not distributing profits to the founder.
spec_domains_text: Registration, renewal and DNS management may have a dedicated subscription. Scope, third-party fees and terms must be published; no plan is currently sold here.
spec_royalties_text: Commercial distribution requires an agreement defining rates, calculation basis, fees, refunds and payment dates. Statements must be reproducible; payments are settled only after confirmation. No universal rate is specified.
spec_treasury_text: Operating funds, reserves and third-party liabilities must be distinguished and reconciled. Locked investments are not available liquidity; neither returns nor preservation of capital are guaranteed.
spec_extensions_text: VPN and wallet capabilities require separate specifications and threat models. A per-account ledger is not automatically a blockchain wallet. These modules are not enabled.
spec_rights_text: Users retain rights to their projects. The platform has a proprietary license; public visibility does not mean open source. Third-party components, contributions and commercial agreements retain their applicable terms.
specIntro: The project described in our documents, feature by feature.
scopeNote: Statuses distinguish local prototype features from planned or undecided modules. Planned features are not enabled.
